name: Purchase Request Processing
description: Discovered from company events: how purchase requests actually move from submission to purchase order.

steps.name: Purchase request
steps.description: A purchase request is submitted by a requesting employee.

steps.name: Extract information
steps.description: Request fields are read from the submitted document.

steps.name: Identify supplier
steps.description: The supplier is matched against the supplier register.

steps.name: Verify price
steps.description: Compares the quoted price with supplier records.

steps.name: Check policy
steps.description: The request is checked against company policy.

steps.name: Search historical decisions
steps.description: Past decisions on similar requests are retrieved for review.

steps.name: Manager approval
steps.description: A manager approves or rejects the purchase request.

steps.name: Create purchase order
steps.description: The purchase order is created once approval is recorded.
